Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Create an Ansible playbook that installs the OpenTelemetry Collector (binary or yum/apt repository), configures it to receive OTLP on port 4317 and export to a remote endpoint, and starts it as a systemd service.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
---
- name: Install and configure OpenTelemetry Collector
  hosts: all
  become: true
  vars:
    otelcol_version: "0.99.0"
    otelcol_arch_map:
      x86_64: amd64
      aarch64: arm64
      armv7l: armv7
    otelcol_arch: "{{ otelcol_arch_map.get(ansible_architecture, 'amd64') }}"
    otelcol_download_base: "https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-releases/releases/download/v{{ otelcol_version }}"
    otelcol_tarball: "otelcol_{{ otelcol_version }}_linux_{{ otelcol_arch }}.tar.gz"
    otelcol_checksums_file: "otelcol_{{ otelcol_version }}_checksums.txt"
    otelcol_install_dir: "/opt/otelcol-{{ otelcol_version }}"
    otelcol_binary_path: "/usr/local/bin/otelcol"
    otelcol_user: "otelcol"
    otelcol_group: "otelcol"
    otelcol_config_dir: "/etc/otelcol"
    otelcol_env_file: "/etc/otelcol/otelcol.env"
    # Required: remote OTLP gRPC endpoint, e.g. "otlp.example.com:4317"
    otlp_exporter_endpoint: ""
    # Optional security and headers
    otlp_exporter_insecure: false
    # Additional static headers (non-sensitive). Example: {"x-tenant": "prod"}
    otlp_exporter_headers: {}
    # Sensitive Authorization header value (e.g., "Bearer <token>") stored in env file
    otlp_exporter_authorization: ""
    otlp_exporter_timeout: "10s"
    manage_firewall: false

  pre_tasks:
    - name: Validate required exporter endpoint
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - otlp_exporter_endpoint is string
          - otlp_exporter_endpoint | length > 0
        fail_msg: "You must set 'otlp_exporter_endpoint' to the remote OTLP endpoint (e.g., otlp.example.com:4317)."

    - name: Ensure required packages are present (Debian/Ubuntu)
      ansible.builtin.apt:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - tar
          - gzip
        state: present
        update_cache: yes
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Ensure required packages are present (RedHat/CentOS/Amazon Linux)
      ansible.builtin.yum:
        name:
          - ca-certificates
          - tar
          - gzip
        state: present
      when: ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

  tasks:
    - name: Create otelcol group
      ansible.builtin.group:
        name: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true

    - name: Create otelcol user
      ansible.builtin.user:
        name: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        system: true
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        create_home: false

    - name: Create configuration and data directories
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ item.path }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ otelcol_user }}"
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: "{{ item.mode | default('0750') }}"
      loop:
        - { path: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}", mode: "0750" }
        - { path: "/var/lib/otelcol", mode: "0750" }
        - { path: "/var/log/otelcol", mode: "0750" }

    - name: Download checksums file
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ otelcol_download_base }}/{{ otelcol_checksums_file }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otelcol_checksums_file }}"
        mode: '0644'
        force: true
        timeout: 60

    - name: Derive checksum for tarball
      ansible.builtin.shell: "grep ' {{ otelcol_tarball }}$' /tmp/{{ otelcol_checksums_file }} | awk '{print $1}'"
      args:
        executable: /bin/bash
      register: otelcol_sha256
      changed_when: false
      check_mode: false

    - name: Fail if checksum not found
      ansible.builtin.assert:
        that:
          - otelcol_sha256.stdout is match('^[a-f0-9]{64}$')
        fail_msg: "Could not find SHA256 for {{ otelcol_tarball }} in checksums file."

    - name: Download OpenTelemetry Collector tarball
      ansible.builtin.get_url:
        url: "{{ otelcol_download_base }}/{{ otelcol_tarball }}"
        dest: "/tmp/{{ otelcol_tarball }}"
        mode: '0644'
        checksum: "sha256:{{ otelcol_sha256.stdout }}"
        timeout: 120

    - name: Create install directory
      ansible.builtin.file:
        path: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}"
        state: directory
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Unarchive otelcol tarball
      ansible.builtin.unarchive:
        src: "/tmp/{{ otelcol_tarball }}"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}"
        remote_src: true
        creates: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}/otelcol"

    - name: Symlink otelcol binary to /usr/local/bin
      ansible.builtin.file:
        src: "{{ otelcol_install_dir }}/otelcol"
        dest: "{{ otelcol_binary_path }}"
        state: link
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0755'
      notify:
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Write environment file
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_env_file }}"
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: '0640'
        content: |
          {% if otlp_exporter_authorization is string %}
          OTLP_EXPORTER_AUTHORIZATION={{ otlp_exporter_authorization }}
          {% else %}
          OTLP_EXPORTER_AUTHORIZATION=
          {% endif %}
      notify:
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Deploy otelcol configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: '0640'
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317

          processors:
            batch:
              timeout: 5s
              send_batch_size: 8192

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otlp_exporter_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otlp_exporter_insecure | bool }}
              headers:
                {% if otlp_exporter_authorization | length > 0 %}
                authorization: ${env:OTLP_EXPORTER_AUTHORIZATION}
                {% endif %}
                {% for item in otlp_exporter_headers | dict2items %}
                {{ item.key }}: "{{ item.value }}"
                {% endfor %}
              timeout: "{{ otlp_exporter_timeout }}"
            logging:
              loglevel: warn

          extensions:
            health_check: {}

          service:
            extensions: [health_check]
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
      notify:
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd unit for otelcol
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otelcol_user }}
          Group={{ otelcol_group }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ otelcol_env_file }}
          ExecStart={{ otelcol_binary_path }} --config={{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5
          LimitNOFILE=65536

          # Hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          ProtectSystem=full
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          SystemCallFilter=@system-service

          RuntimeDirectory=otelcol
          StateDirectory=otelcol

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - Reload systemd
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Open firewall port 4317/tcp with firewalld (optional)
      ansible.posix.firewalld:
        port: 4317/tcp
        permanent: true
        state: enabled
        immediate: true
      when:
        - manage_firewall | bool
        - ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Open firewall port 4317/tcp with UFW (optional)
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: '4317'
        proto: tcp
      when:
        - manage_firewall | bool
        - ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Enable and start otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

  handlers:
    - name: Reload systemd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted
        enabled: true

        content: |
          {% if otlp_exporter_authorization is string %}
          OTLP_EXPORTER_AUTHORIZATION={{ otlp_exporter_authorization }}
          {% else %}
          OTLP_EXPORTER_AUTHORIZATION=
          {% endif %}
      notify:
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Deploy otelcol configuration
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: "{{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml"
        owner: root
        group: "{{ otelcol_group }}"
        mode: '0640'
        content: |
          receivers:
            otlp:
              protocols:
                grpc:
                  endpoint: 0.0.0.0:4317

          processors:
            batch:
              timeout: 5s
              send_batch_size: 8192

          exporters:
            otlp:
              endpoint: "{{ otlp_exporter_endpoint }}"
              tls:
                insecure: {{ otlp_exporter_insecure | bool }}
              headers:
                {% if otlp_exporter_authorization | length > 0 %}
                authorization: ${env:OTLP_EXPORTER_AUTHORIZATION}
                {% endif %}
                {% for item in otlp_exporter_headers | dict2items %}
                {{ item.key }}: "{{ item.value }}"
                {% endfor %}
              timeout: "{{ otlp_exporter_timeout }}"
            logging:
              loglevel: warn

          extensions:
            health_check: {}

          service:
            extensions: [health_check]
            pipelines:
              traces:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              metrics:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
              logs:
                receivers: [otlp]
                processors: [batch]
                exporters: [otlp]
      notify:
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Create systemd unit for otelcol
      ansible.builtin.copy:
        dest: /etc/systemd/system/otelcol.service
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
        content: |
          [Unit]
          Description=OpenTelemetry Collector
          After=network-online.target
          Wants=network-online.target

          [Service]
          Type=simple
          User={{ otelcol_user }}
          Group={{ otelcol_group }}
          EnvironmentFile=-{{ otelcol_env_file }}
          ExecStart={{ otelcol_binary_path }} --config={{ otelcol_config_dir }}/config.yaml
          Restart=on-failure
          RestartSec=5
          LimitNOFILE=65536

          # Hardening
          NoNewPrivileges=true
          PrivateTmp=true
          PrivateDevices=true
          ProtectSystem=full
          ProtectHome=true
          ProtectControlGroups=true
          ProtectKernelModules=true
          ProtectKernelTunables=true
          LockPersonality=true
          MemoryDenyWriteExecute=true
          CapabilityBoundingSet=
          AmbientCapabilities=
          RestrictAddressFamilies=AF_INET AF_INET6 AF_UNIX
          SystemCallArchitectures=native
          SystemCallFilter=@system-service

          RuntimeDirectory=otelcol
          StateDirectory=otelcol

          [Install]
          WantedBy=multi-user.target
      notify:
        - Reload systemd
        - Restart otelcol

    - name: Open firewall port 4317/tcp with firewalld (optional)
      ansible.posix.firewalld:
        port: 4317/tcp
        permanent: true
        state: enabled
        immediate: true
      when:
        - manage_firewall | bool
        - ansible_os_family == "RedHat"

    - name: Open firewall port 4317/tcp with UFW (optional)
      community.general.ufw:
        rule: allow
        port: '4317'
        proto: tcp
      when:
        - manage_firewall | bool
        - ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Enable and start otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        enabled: true
        state: started
        daemon_reload: true

  handlers:
    - name: Reload systemd
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        daemon_reload: true

    - name: Restart otelcol
      ansible.builtin.systemd:
        name: otelcol
        state: restarted
        enabled: true
